capabilities: convert Apple Journal HTML entries into Markdown notes
embed photos, videos, and audio from the export into each note
convert HEIC images to JPEG using the macOS sips command
write YAML frontmatter and special asset markers (location, workout, state of mind)
show import progress and an error summary after import
extras: Community-plugin listing is listed as 'coming soon', so manual installation from Releases is currently the documented path. HEIC conversion only works on macOS (uses the built-in sips command) and can be disabled; only the English Apple Journal export format is recognized.
problem: Obsidian cannot directly read Apple Journal's export format of HTML files and a media archive, so journal entries and their media cannot be brought into a vault as-is.

requires.name: macOS with sips for HEIC conversion

summary: Importer that converts Apple Journal HTML exports into Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter and embedded media, converting HEIC images to JPEG.
